competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every 'write' item is multiple-choice selection rather than free production — e.g. seed 43's 3/4 answer is chosen from four listed options — so no sample requires a student to actually construct fraction notation from scratch as 'write' implies.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Seven of eight samples go picture-to-notation (e.g. seed 44's 3/8) while only seed 55 ('Shade 2/5 of the shape') requires reading a given notation and acting on it, leaving the 'read' half of this competency thinly covered.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentences such as seed 45's 'A shape is divided into 8 equal parts. 1 part is shaded.' remain short and literal, appropriate for grade 2 quarter 4.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Format types span mcq, read_mcq, set_click and cloze across the eight samples, giving surface-level variety even though the content is repetitive.

competency_alignment.rationale: This node's eight samples are identical to sibling node mat_g2_na_q4_3's ('Represent and identify similar fractions...') content, so nothing distinguishes 'read and write... notation' from the neighboring represent/identify competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Denominators used (3, 4, 5, 8, per seed 44's 3/8 and seed 42's 2/5) stay within the expected similar-fraction range for this grade.
